verdict.line: You lose if you eat his Q chip for free without ever landing E back on him; you win every fight where you get your spirit rip off and he either dies to it or walks into your R.

brief.thesis: This is a brawl Illaoi is built to win: her Tentacle passive and E (Test of Spirit) sustain and echo damage back onto Malphite faster than his Granite Shield and poke can offset it. The data backs this exactly — 50.4% over 889 games with lane and solo-kill advantage to Illaoi — so the matchup isn't hard, it's a question of whether you let him poke you down uncontested or force the brawl on your terms.

theirWindow.when: he's landed 2-3 free Q's on you
theirWindow.what: His Q (Seismic Shard, 8s cooldown) chips you and steals your move speed every time it lands uncontested. If you're not answering with E (Test of Spirit) or a Q (Tentacle Smash) tentacle hit in between, back off the wave edge instead of standing in a second and third Q — don't let the poke stack for free.

yourWindow.when: the instant his R (Unstoppable Force) lands
yourWindow.what: Unstoppable Force commits him into melee range on a 130/115/100/80/80s cooldown. The moment he lands it on you, answer with E (Test of Spirit) into R (Leap of Faith) — per measured play this combo kills him outright, and he has no R back for minutes.

start.why: The sustain and lifesteal (53.6% WR over 548 games) let you stand in his Q poke and still win the all-in trade once E is up.

boots.why: Cuts the duration of his Q slow and his E attack-speed reduction, and the magic resist blunts his armor-scaling E and his R damage (50.5% over 685 games).

core.why: Shreds the armor he stacks from W (Brutal Strikes) and from base growth, which is exactly what lets your autos and tentacles keep hurting him through a brawl.
The on-cast shield procs every time you W (Harsh Lesson) leap in, giving you a damage buffer right as you close the gap through his Q.
Raw HP and the damage-reduction proc keep you alive through his R knockup all-in and any follow-up poke (59.8% over 127 games on this path).

situational.when: he's chipping you down with repeated Q/E poke and you want your tentacle and vessel healing amplified
their team adds burst magic damage on top of his kit and you need to delay death through a fight
you're ahead and want to snowball the lane into more single-target burst instead of sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: You want to win extended trades, not short burst exchanges — Grasp heals you through his Q poke and his E magic damage every time you're the one standing in melee range.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite posts the highest measured win rate in this matchup (56.4%), and it matches the data's solo-kill advantage — Ignite turns your E/R punish window into a secured kill instead of just a big trade.

playing.title: Break Granite Shield before committing
playing.detail: Malphite's passive shields him if he hasn't been hit recently. Poke it down with a Q (Tentacle Smash) tentacle or an auto before you commit your W (Harsh Lesson) leap, or your burst gets eaten by the shield.

playing.title: Rip spirit and keep swinging
playing.detail: E (Test of Spirit) forces his spirit to echo a percentage of the damage it takes back onto him. Land it, then keep hitting through the duration — every auto and tentacle swing is doubled damage onto Malphite.

playing.title: Punish any R engage with E into R
playing.detail: His R (Unstoppable Force) commits him to melee range and is on a long cooldown (130/115/100/80/80s). The moment he lands it, answer with E (Test of Spirit) into R (Leap of Faith) for a kill.

playing.title: Don't eat free Q's
playing.detail: His Q (Seismic Shard, 8s cooldown) slows and chips you from range. If you're taking several without landing E or a tentacle hit back, step off the wave instead of absorbing more.

playing.title: Leap through the slow, don't walk into it
playing.detail: W (Harsh Lesson) is a 4-second-cooldown leap that also pulls nearby tentacles onto your target. Use it to close distance through his Q slow rather than walking in and eating a second Q.

playing.title: Threaten the Vessel conversion
playing.detail: If his spirit from E dies or he runs too far from it, he becomes a Vessel spawning tentacles that heal you on every hit. Play E aggressively on wave resets to set this up before a dive or all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above come from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Illaoi has the upper hand brawling even after a couple of Malphite’s (Q). If Malphite uses (R) on her, Illaoi can easily kill him with [E]-[R]. Be careful, however, of being hit with (Q) too many times without striking back with [E].
